title: Negative numbers
examples: How do I add two negative numbers together?
What does it mean to subtract a negative number?
Can you show me negative numbers on the number line?

explain.say: Today we are learning about negative numbers. These numbers are smaller than zero. We can see them on a number line.
On the number line, zero is the middle point. Numbers to the right are positive. Numbers to the left are negative.

draw.text: Negative numbers are left of zero.

explain.say: Let us look at temperature. If the temperature is minus five degrees, it is very cold indeed. This means five degrees below zero.
When we add, we move further left if the number is negative. For example, starting at one, and adding minus three takes us to minus two.
Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding a positive number. This is a very important rule to remember always.

items: Subtracting a negative is adding positive

faq.q: What is the opposite of a negative number?
faq.a: The opposite of a negative number is its positive counterpart. For example, the opposite of minus four is positive four.
asks: How do I find the opposite sign?

faq.q: When I add two negative numbers, do I just add the numbers?
faq.a: Yes, you add the absolute values and keep the negative sign. For example, minus two plus minus three equals minus five.
asks: If I add -4 and -1, what is the answer?
Do I just add the numbers and keep it negative?

faq.q: Does subtracting a negative number mean I do nothing?
faq.a: No, it means you change the subtraction sign to an addition sign. Subtracting a negative is like adding a positive.

faq.q: How do I use the number line for subtraction?
faq.a: Start at the first number. If you are subtracting a negative, you move to the right on the number line.
asks: If I go from -2 and subtract -3, where do I land?
Does subtraction always mean moving left?

faq.q: Can I use negative numbers for money?
faq.a: Yes, you can think of owing money as a negative amount. If you owe ten pounds, that is minus ten pounds.
asks: If my balance is minus twenty, what does that mean?

facts: Negative numbers are integers less than zero.
On a number line, negative numbers are located to the left of zero.
Adding two negative numbers results in a more negative number.
Subtracting a negative number is equivalent to adding a positive number.

quiz.say: What is the result of minus six plus minus two?
quiz.why: When adding two negative numbers, you add the values and the result stays negative.

wrong.1: This is tempting because you might only add the numbers and ignore the negative signs.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you must keep the negative sign when adding two negatives.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you must keep the negative sign when adding two negatives.

quiz.say: Calculate the value of five minus minus three.
quiz.why: Subtracting a negative number changes the operation to addition, so we add five and three.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you might subtract the numbers instead of changing the operation.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you incorrectly added both numbers and kept the negative sign.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you might add the absolute values without changing the sign.

quiz.say: If the temperature is minus ten degrees and it rises by twelve degrees, what is the new temperature?
quiz.why: Rising temperature means adding a positive number, so we calculate minus ten plus twelve.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you subtracted the positive increase instead of adding it.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you added the absolute values without considering the starting point.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you subtracted the smaller number from the larger number.
